lines.t: I feast upon what feeds my soul, not bread that fades away
I remember You, Your Passion, Lord, the price You chose to pay
I lift my thanks before Your throne, for mercy rich and true
My heart laid bare before Your eyes, made clean because of You
Unleaven my heart Lord, search me deep within
Unleaven my heart Lord, cleanse me from all sin
Not by the work of my hands
But by the truth of who I am before You
Unleaven my heart Lord, let no pride remain
Unleaven my heart Lord, wash away the stain
I remember Your love, I remember the cost
Unleaven my heart Lord, I am Yours, I am Yours
I bring no boast, no offering that could earn Your grace
For You desire a broken heart that seeks Your face
Your loving mercy calls me now to turn and see
Salvation given freely, Lord, You died for me
Unleaven my heart Lord, make my spirit new
Unleaven my heart Lord, let me walk in You
For the heart speaks louder still
Than any gift I place before You
Unleaven my heart Lord, let no pride remain
Unleaven my heart Lord, wash away the stain
I remember Your love, I remember the cost
Unleaven my heart Lord, I am Yours, I am Yours
Let all corruption fall away
Let truth and light in me stay
A heart made clean, a heart made right
Alive in You, restored in light
Unleaven my heart Lord, I cry out Your name
Unleaven my heart Lord, forever You reign
Unleaven my heart Lord, let no pride remain
Unleaven my heart Lord, wash away the stain
I remember Your love, I remember the cost
Unleaven my heart Lord, I am Yours, I am Yours
I feast on You, my living bread
By mercy’s hand I’m gently led
Unleaven my heart Lord, forever I pray
Unleaven my heart Lord, lead me in Your way
